info.name: Power Utility Management System API
info.description:
All endpoints of the Power Utility Management System backend.

HOW TO USE
1. Import this collection and Local.postman_environment.json
2. Pick the "Power Utility - Local" environment (top-right)
3. Start the backend (npm run dev in the backend folder)
4. Run "Login as Admin" (saves adminToken). Customers log in like on GitHub: run "Login as Customer (step 1)", copy the 8-digit code from the email (or the backend terminal) into the environment variable loginCode, then run "step 2" (saves customerToken)
5. Or press "Run collection" to test everything in order.

Demo logins: PUMSadmin / {{adminPassword}}   and   sumaiya.khanam / customer123
